summary: This directory provides a framework for managing business calendars and performing date-related calculations specific to financial or operational markets. It defines the interface for holiday lookups and adjustment logic required for business day scheduling.
responsibilities: Define interfaces for business day calculations
Identify market-specific holidays and working days
Perform adjustments for month-end and year-end dates
Provide access to business calendar services based on market identifiers
relationships: The Business Calendar interface establishes the standard rules for determining valid working days and holidays within a specific market.
The Business Calendar Service acts as a provider to retrieve specific calendar implementations based on the required market context.
Business day calculations rely on the holiday data provided by the calendar implementation to determine accurate scheduling.
designDecisions: Service-oriented access pattern for retrieving market-specific calendars
Separation of calendar definitions from business logic operations
